notes.title: Daily Deal - Winter Memories Is Now 50% Off!
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44392363/2ab19868b738d81b0476b6ec2a42cd5d10cc0c29.png

Winter Memories is now featured in the Daily Deal for a limited time! You can grab Winter Memories with a massive 50% off discount!

If you haven't played it yet, now's the perfect time to dive in. Don't miss your chance to experience this unforgettable winter! This special offer runs from September 2 to September 16!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2495450/Winter_Memories/

Don't forget to also check out the upcoming first DLC to Kagura Survivors: Endless Night! Featuring Miyuki, Rio, and Yui from the hit game Summer Memories!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3235000/Kagura_Survivors_x_Summer_Memories/

Don't forget to also follow us on our Steam Publisher page and join our Discord to stay up to date with everything related to Kagura Games!

Once again, we want to thank you for your support and hope you'll enjoy our upcoming releases!
